title: Norsine denies a government cover story for the abduction

tellings.quote: He said, "No." And he believed in what he said.

plain: A man named John Norsine, linked to an alien abduction case in Newport, Rhode Island, flatly denied that the abduction was a government cover story. Jim Weiner, who tells the abduction story, says he put the question to Norsine, who simply said "No," and Weiner says Norsine believed what he said. This matters to Weiner because it counts against the idea that the event was staged by the government.
